long_title: ROSETTA Lung-202: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase 3 Study of Pumitamig Monotherapy Compared to Pembrolizumab as First-line Treatment in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With PD-L1 ≥ 50%.
prior_treatment_requirements: * Participants must have a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (squamous and nonsquamous) with Stage IIIB/IIIC or Stage IV disease.
* Participants must have a programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) expression ≥ 50%.
* Participants must have measurable disease as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
* Participants must have no prior systemic anti-tumor therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.
* Participants must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0-1.
Exclude - * Participants must not have any documented actionable genomic alteration (AGA) for which first-line (1L) approved therapies are indicated.
Exclude - * Participants must not have any symptomatic untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal metastases (carcinomatous meningitis) or spinal cord compression.

Exclude - * Participants must not have any significant cardiovascular impairment as evidenced by uncontrolled hypertension (despite optimal medical treatment), congestive heart failure, active coronary disease (within 6 months prior to randomization), ventricular arrhythmias, or major thrombotic or embolic events or major hemorrhagic events (within 6 months prior to randomization), or significant risk of pulmonary hemorrhage.
Exclude - * Participants must not an active autoimmune disease.
Exclude - * Other protocol-defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria apply.
short_title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Pumitamig Versus Pembrolizumab in Participants With Previously Untreated Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and PD-L1 ≥ 50%. (ROSETTA Lung-202)
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of Pumitamig versus Pembrolizumab in participants with previously untreated advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and PD-L1 ≥ 50%.
